resources.string: DisciplineX App Lock checks which app owns each window on screen, so it can send you back to your challenge until it is done (including apps opened in split-screen or small floating windows). Phone, Camera and your allowed apps stay available. To stop the app being uninstalled to dodge the lock, it also looks at the system uninstall dialog, only to see whether it is about DisciplineX. It never reads your messages, passwords or anything you type.
